verdict.rationale: CRA's e-services page lists the ability to "track the progress of files submitted to the CRA", and EFILE filers can view their transmission history, but both require signing in. Neither is a lookup on public pages. The only truly public lookups are adjacent: finding an existing BN and searching the GST/HST registry. missing for 10: a documented status lookup for filings, applications or cases on public (unauthenticated) pages, detail on what tracking covers (BN registration, program accounts, cases) and how it works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
